name: Outbound Prospecting
tagline: A four-step outbound workflow — target list, right person, real reason to reach out, and a draft that doesn't smell like AI.
who: Founders and sellers doing their own outbound who want a repeatable prospecting system — and refuse to send the AI slop everyone else is blasting.
how: Your agent walks you through four checkpointed steps: define your ICP and build the company list (with Clay if you use it), find the right person at each company, dig up a genuine connection trigger — mutual ties, a firm-level problem, or common ground — then guide you through your own template so every email reads like you wrote it. Nothing sends itself: you approve every draft, and you hit send.
